newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Ecotek sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Ecotek sets stock split.

text.p: Thermo Ecotek Corp said on Wednesday that its board has declared a three-for-two stock split in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend.
The stock dividend, which will increase the number of shares to 24 million, is payable on October 16, 1996 to shareholders of record as of October 2, the company said.
Financial results for prior periods will be restated to reflect the stock dividend, the company said.
Thermo Ecotek is a public subsidiary of Thermo Electron Corp.
